name: YuLan-Base 12B
description:
YuLan is a 12B open-source LLM from Renmin University of China, described in Zhu et al., “YuLan: An Open-source Large Language Model” (arXiv:2406.19853). The base model is pretrained from scratch on about 1.7T English, Chinese, and multilingual tokens with a three-stage curriculum; the chat model then takes instruction-tuning and human alignment. Training finished in January 2024. Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.19853

Here is how to read the YuLan-Base 12B config.json. The architecture class is LlamaForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 4,864: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 51,190 × 4,864: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 38, so each head sees 128 dimensions (4,864 / 38). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 4864 / 38 = 128. 128 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_key_value_heads is 38, so this is multi-head attention (MHA): every query head keeps its own key/value.

num_hidden_layers is 40: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

intermediate_size is 13,056. In a SwiGLU MLP this is the high-dimensional workspace: the 4,864-wide stream is projected up, activated with silu, then projected back. Labs usually round this width to a multiple of 128 or 256 so it tiles on the chip.

max_position_embeddings is 4,096 tokens — the context window in the config. There is no rope_scaling entry, so the rotary positions are used as-is. rope_theta is 10000.0: that is the wavelength of the rotary embedding. A larger theta keeps distant tokens from aliasing after a full rotation.

vocab_size is 51,190. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

tie_word_embeddings is false, so the input embedding matrix and the output LM head are separate learned matrices rather than a shared transpose.

torch_dtype is bfloat16. Brain floating point keeps FP32’s exponent range with less mantissa, which avoids the overflow/underflow of a tiny exponent at the cost of noisier decimals — and it halves the on-chip footprint versus FP32. NVIDIA A100s were the first NVIDIA chips with native BF16; Huawei Ascend 910-class parts also prefer BF16/FP16 on the cube.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/yulan-team/YuLan-Base-12b/blob/main/config.json.
